name: Min/Max Tree Construction with Forward Neighbors
definition: A bounding volume hierarchy built on the octree where each node stores the min/max of the isosurface values within its spatial extent. Because cells are defined by forward neighbors, the min/max for a node must consider not just its 8 children, but also their forward neighbors.
summary: Min/Max Tree Construction with Forward Neighbors builds a bounding volume hierarchy for sparse octrees by incorporating forward-adjacent voxels into leaf-level bounds, ensuring accurate isosurface ray tracing.
